reviews.title: 285k king of 4k gaming
reviews.comment: 285k is a 4k gaming beast. Don't let the paid croney YouTubers fool you. 57 on the p cores and 49 on the e cores npu off thermal limits off(110c in the bios is all that's needed) lift all the limits and let it sing . You can push one p core to 58 and one set of e cores to 50 the lows are better in almost every game I play than the 9800x3d aver is with the error of margin but lows are noticeably better in re5 games
reviews.author: JoelC

reviews.title: Absolute Beast of a CPU!
reviews.comment: This processor is an absolute powerhouse! Upgraded from an older i7, and the difference is night and day. The Core Ultra 9 285K handles gaming, streaming, and editing all at once without breaking a sweat. Temps stay surprisingly cool with a good AIO cooler, and the boost clock speeds are insane. Everything feels faster from boot times to heavy multitasking. If you’re building a high-end rig and want top-tier performance with future-proofing, this CPU delivers big time!
